αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the mules (αἱ δ’ ὦκα λίπον ’and they quickly left’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the islands (αἱ δέ τ’ ἄνευθε ’and they lie apart’) · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the others’ (αἱ ἄλλαι ’the other ships’) · also fem. nom. pl., correlative, of the doors: αἱ μὲν … αἱ δ’ ’the one … the other’ · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the swine (αἱ δὲ νέμονται ’and they graze’)
αἴθ: αἴθε — would that; epic wish particle + opt., elided (αἴθ’ = αἴθε; = εἰ γάρ, αἲ γάρ)
αἵματι: αἷμα — blood; neut. dat. sg.: ’with blood’, instrumental
αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, soon, at once; adv.
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv.
βάζεις: βάζω — chatter, babble, talk; pres. 2 sg.
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’cast’ · also ’hit, strike’, with the person or part struck as object: ’struck’ (βάλε δεξιὸν ὦμον ’struck the right shoulder’)
βάν: βαίνω — step, go, set out; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
βασιλείης: βασίλεια — queen; fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας)
βούλεαι: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic βούλει); with ἤ ’rather than’
βόες: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; masc./fem. nom. pl.
βόσκειν: βόσκω — feed, pasture; pres. inf. act.: ’to feed’
βὰν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἔβησαν): ’they went’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle, accented γέ before a following enclitic
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’
γαστέρ: γαστήρ — belly; fem. acc. sg., elided (γαστέρ’ = γαστέρα)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γοῦνα: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., epic γοῦνα (= Attic γόνατα)
γυναῖκας: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. pl.
δένδρεα: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δένδρα)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίδου: δίδωμι — give; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give!’ · also impf. 3 sg., epic (= ἐδίδου): ’she gave’ (of the Muse)
δαιμόνιοι: δαιμόνιος — strange, possessed, mad; a vocative of rebuke or wonder, not a compliment; masc. voc. pl.
δαισάμενοι: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. feast, dine; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having feasted’
δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; gen. sg., after κορέννυμι: ’sated with the feast’ · also gen. after δεύομαι ’lack’: ’lacking the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης) · also gen. sg. depending on a noun: ’of the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἀνίην ’the vexation of the feast’)
δείλ: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. voc. sg., elided (δείλ’ = δείλε), in the exclamation ἆ δείλε
δείσας: δείδω — fear, be afraid; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having grown afraid’
δεπάεσσιν: δέπας — cup; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
δικαίῳ: δίκαιος — just, righteous (one who gives what is due); masc. dat. sg.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’)
διὲκ: διέκ — out through, right through; prep. + gen. (διά + ἐκ, epic)
δμώων: δμώς — slave, bondman (esp. war-captive); masc. gen. pl.
δοίην: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I would give’
δοκέει: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖ)
δοκέεις: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖς)
δοῦρε: δόρυ — spear, shaft; acc. dual, epic stem δουρ-: ’two spears’
δύη: δύη — woe, distress, pain; fem. nom. sg.
δώμαθ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώμαθ’ = δώματα before a rough breathing)
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δώματος: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. gen. sg., governed by the adv. εἴσω: ’within the house’ · also gen. sg. governed by διά: ’through the house’ (διὰ δώματος)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εἴα: ἐάω — allow, permit; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’allowed’
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’) · also in a wish after εἰ γάρ, ’if only (all things) were’ · also in a fear clause after μή, ’lest it be (a god)’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if he were’ (εἰ τοιόσδ’ εἴη) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’who he was’ (τίς εἴη) · also in a negative wish with μή, ’may (no man) be’ · also potential opt. with κε in a relative clause, ’which would be’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’)
εἴπεσκεν: εἶπον — say, speak; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic εἶπε): ’would say, used to say’
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: εἵματα γάρ ῥ’ ἐβάρυνε ’for the clothes weighed him down’
εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in an indirect question: ’(who) they might be’ · also with κε, potential: ’would be’ (κ’ … εἶεν) · also in a concessive condition after εἰ: ’were’ (οὐδ’ εἴ οἱ χεῖρες … εἶεν ’not even if he had hands’) · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may (they) be’ (ἔνδον ἑταῖροι εἶεν ’may my companions be inside’)
εὐρέα: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα ’broad backs’ (ἐπ’ εὐρέα νῶτα θαλάσσης ’over the broad back of the sea’) · also masc. acc. sg., epic by-form of εὐρύν, agreeing with a masc. noun (θαλάσσης εὐρέα κόλπον ’the sea’s broad bosom’)
εὐρυμάχῳ: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a suitor of Penelope; masc. dat. sg.
εὐρύμαχ: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a leading suitor; masc. voc. sg., elided (Εὐρύμαχ’ = Εὐρύμαχε)
εὐρύμαχον: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a leading suitor, son of Polybus; masc. acc. sg.
εὐρύμαχος: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a leading suitor, son of Polybus; masc. nom. sg.
εὕδειν: εὕδω — sleep; pres. inf.: ’to sleep’ (with ὤρνυντο, ’bestirred themselves to sleep’)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle · also with the relative ὅθι, no connective force: ὅθι θ’ ’where’
θαύμαζον: θαυμάζω — marvel at, wonder at; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεράπων: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. sg.
θητευέμεν: θητεύω — work for hire, serve as a labourer (θής); pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic θητεύειν)
θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg. · also life, the breath of life
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’)
κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. (elided κάκ’): ’evils, misfortunes’ · also neut. nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά), agreeing with ἀράχνια: ’foul (cobwebs)’
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ · also plain acc. sg., direct object of a verb: κινήσας κάρη ’shaking his head’ · also acc. sg. governed by ἀμφί: ’about the head’ (ἀμφὶ κάρη)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a clause after εἴ: ’whether perhaps’ (εἴ κέ σφι … τελευτήσει ’whether … it will come to pass for them’) · also + opt., potential, in a main clause: ’might’ (καί κέ τεο … πειρηθεῖμεν ’we might test any of’)
κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
καθέζετο: καθέζομαι — sit down, seat oneself; impf. 3 sg.: ’sat down’
καθαπτόμενος: καθάπτομαι — accost, address directly, fasten on with words; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg.: ’a bad thing, evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’) · also neut. nom. sg. adjective agreeing with πέλωρ: ’evil’ (πέλωρ κακόν ’an evil monster’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun, predicate: ’an evil’ (ἀθάνατον κακόν ’an immortal evil’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun with a comparative, predicate: ’a greater evil’ (μεῖζον … κακόν)
καλλιπάρῃος: καλλιπάρῃος — fair-cheeked; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg., epic -ῃος, from παρῃά ’cheek’ (Attic παρειά); epithet of Helen
κατακείετε: κατακείω — lie down, go to bed (built on the stem of κεῖμαι); pres. imper. 2 pl., epic
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.
κεράσσατο: κεράννυμι — mix (wine with water); aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, epic σσ (= Attic ἐκεράσατο)
κεῖσ: κεῖσε — thither, to that place; adv., elided (κεῖσ’ = κεῖσε)
κηρόθι: κῆρ — heart; with the suffix -θι of place: ’in the heart’, adv.
κονίῃσι: κονία — dust; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κονίαις)
κραδίην: κραδίη — heart (epic = Attic καρδία); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
κρητῆρα: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. sg.
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κὰκ: κατά (apocope κὰκ before κ-) — down; prep. + gen., ’down from’ (κὰκ κεφαλῆς) · also preverb in tmesis (κὰκ … εἴρυσσε = κατεῖρυσε ’drew down’)
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’)
λέγων: λέγω — say, tell, recount; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’telling’
λαερτιάδεω: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), a patronymic of Odysseus
λύθεν: λύω — loosen, release, undo; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἐλύθησαν)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγαρα: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. acc. pl.
μέγας: μέγας — great, big, grown; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’grown’ · also plain attributive adj., masc. nom. sg., ’great, huge’ (μέγας σῦς ’a great boar’), not predicate
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’)
μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δούρατα μακρὰ ’long timbers’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’with long (steps)’ (μακρὰ βιβάς ’striding with long steps’)
μεγάλοι: μέγας — great, large; masc. nom. pl.
μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ‘in the halls’
μελεϊστὶ: μελεϊστί — limb by limb, piecemeal; adv. (from μέλος ’limb’)
μελιηδέα: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (adj. of two endings) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun (μελιηδέα καρπόν ’honey-sweet fruit’)
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’) · also + gen., ’among, in company with’ (μετ’ ἄλλων … ἑταίρων ’among your other companions’)
μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic μετεῖπε)
μετέειφ: μετεῖπον (μετά + εἶπον) — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (μετέειφ’ = μετέειπε)
μεταμώνια: μεταμώνιος — wasted, vain, gone to the winds; neut. nom. pl.
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’) · also gen. sg. with a participle: ’of me hearing’ (μευ ἀκούοντος, with φίλον ἦτορ ’heart’) · also gen. with κήδομαι: ’care for me’ (ἦ μευ … κήδεαι ’you care for me’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνηστῆρες: μνηστήρ — suitor; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’suitors!’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μυθήσασθαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; aor. inf. mid.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νίσου: Νῖσος — Nisus, father of Amphinomus; masc. gen. sg.
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νώμησεν: νωμάω — distribute, deal out; aor. 3 sg.: ’distributed’
νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
οἰμώξας: οἰμώζω — wail, groan aloud; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having groaned’
οἰνοχόος: οἰνοχόος — wine-pourer, cupbearer; masc. nom. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὕνεκα: οὕνεκα (crasis of οὗ ἕνεκα) — because; also relative: for the sake of which, for which reason; conj. · also ’that’, introducing what a messenger is to tell (= ὅτι): ἐρέοντα … οὕνεκα ’to tell that’
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πέλονται: πέλομαι — be, become, prove to be; pres. 3 pl.
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
πέσεν: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσεν): ’fell’
παρείη: πάρειμι — be at hand, be present; pres. opt. 3 sg. (remote condition): ’were at hand’
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’)
πηνελοπείης: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; fem. gen. sg., epic Πηνελοπείης (= Attic Πηνελόπης)
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
πλησίον: πλησίος — near, neighbouring; neut. acc. sg. as adv. πλησίον: ’near, beside’
ποίης: ποῖος — of what sort, what kind of; fem. gen. sg. · also ποίη — grass; fem. gen. sg. (ἄνθεα ποίης ’flowers of the grass’)
ποίῃ: ποῖος — of what kind, which?; interrog. adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (= Attic ποίᾳ), with νηΐ
ποθεν: πόθεν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’from where?’
πολλοῖσι: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic πολλοῖς)
πολλῷ: πολύς — much, great, many; masc./neut. dat. sg.
πολύβου: Πόλυβος — Polybus, father of Eurymachus; masc. gen. sg.
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
ποσίν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., dat. of means or respect: ’with the feet’
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
προθύροιο: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρώτοισιν: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’ · also + gen., ’in the eyes of, with’ (πρὸς πόσιός τε καὶ υἱέος ’in the eyes of her husband and son’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πτωχῶν: πτωχός — beggar; masc. gen. pl.: ’of beggars’
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’) · also a preposition + gen., ’from (the side of)’ (πὰρ Ταφίων ’from the Taphians’)
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σήμερον: σήμερον — today, this day; adv. (Attic τήμερον)
σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σκιόεντα: σκιόεις — shadowy, dim; neut. acc. pl.
σπείσαντες: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
σπεῖσάν: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσπεισαν)
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στιβαρῇσι: στιβαρός — stout, sturdy, strong; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic) · also article-like with ἄλλα, ’the other (things)’ (τά περ ἄλλα ’in the other matters’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέω: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil, bring to pass; fut. 1 sg. (contracted from τελέσω): ’I will accomplish’
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.

τηλεμάχῳ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.

τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιοῦτος: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; demonstrative pron./adj., masc. nom. sg.
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τρίχες: θρίξ — hair, bristle; fem. nom. pl. (stem τριχ-)
τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg. · also as a proper name, Φαίδιμος — Phaedimus, king of the Sidonians who gave Menelaus the silver bowl; masc. nom. sg.
φιλέεσκεν: φιλέω — love, be fond of; impf. iterative 3 sg., epic -εσκεν, uncontracted and unaugmented: ’used to love’
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φυτεύων: φυτεύω — plant, sow; devise (evils); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’working (evil) for’
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φύντες: φύω — grow; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., used adverbially (ὀδὰξ ἐν χείλεσι φύντες ’having bitten their lips’)
χαλεπαίνοι: χαλεπαίνω — be fierce, rage (of weather); pres. opt. 3 sg., general condition
χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.
χείλεσι: χεῖλος — lip; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσι
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
ἀγήνορας: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. acc. pl.
ἀγακλειτῆς: ἀγακλειτός — very glorious, famed; fem. gen. sg.
ἀγορήσατο: ἀγοράομαι — speak in the assembly; aor. 3 sg. mid.
ἀγορεύειν: ἀγορεύω — speak (esp. in assembly); pres. inf.
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀγροῦ: ἀγρός — field, countryside; gen. sg. (ἐπ’ ἀγροῦ ’out in the country’) · also plain gen. sg. dependent on a noun, ’of the field/farmland’: ἀγροῦ ἐπ’ ἐσχατιήν ’to the edge of the farmland’
ἀγόρευε: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευε)
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθύρματα: ἄθυρμα — plaything, trinket; neut. acc. pl.
ἀλήτην: ἀλήτης — wanderer, vagrant, beggar; masc. acc. sg.
ἀληθέα: ἀληθής — true; adj., neut. acc. pl.: ‘the truth, true things’
ἀλώμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀμείνων: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, masc. nom. sg.: ’better’
ἀμφίνομος: Ἀμφίνομος — Amphinomus, one of the suitors; masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀραρυῖα: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (masc. ἀρηρώς): ’fitted, built’
ἀρητιάδαο: Ἀρητιάδης — son of Aretes, patronymic; masc. gen. sg., epic -άδαο (= Attic -άδου), agreeing with Νίσου

ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλοθ: ἄλλοτε — at another time, elsewhere, ever again; adv., elided (ἄλλοθ’ = ἄλλοτε) · also ἄλλοθι — elsewhere, in another place; adv., elided (ἄλλοθ’ ὄληται ’perishes elsewhere, far away’)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual pron./adj., used with a dual verb · also with a plural noun: ἄμφω χεῖρας ’both hands’ · also in apposition to a plural subject: ’both of us’ (ἱκόμεθ’ ἄμφω)
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential)
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄνωγε: ἄνωγα — command, bid, order; perf. with pres./past force, 3 sg.: ’bade, had bidden’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’what things’
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἆ: ἆ — ah!, oh!; interjection of dismay or reproach
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows · also accented before the enclitic τε: σύ τ’ ἐγώ τε ’you and I’ · also accented before the elided enclitic ποτ’ (ποτέ): ἐγώ ποτ’ ’I once’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐθέλοις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 2 sg.
ἐλαυνέμεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, row; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐλαύνειν)
ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνένιπεν: ἐνίπτω (aor. ἐνένιπον) — rebuke, chide; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist: ’rebuked’
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)

ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
ἐπηετανὸν: ἐπηετανός — continuous, unfailing, year-long; neut. acc. sg.
ἐπισταδόν: ἐπισταδόν — one after another, standing close by; adv.
ἐποίχεσθαι: ἐποίχομαι — go about, ply (a task); pres. inf.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐριδαίνομεν: ἐριδαίνω — strive, vie, contend; pres. 1 pl.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσί: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐσχατιῆς: ἐσχατιή — edge, border, remotest part; fem. gen. sg.
ἐχολώσατο: χολόομαι — be angry, grow wroth; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’grew angry’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἑκάστης: ἕκαστος — each; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with νηός
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑὰ: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. pl.
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’from where she came’ (πόθεν ἔλθοι) · also in a relative clause with κε, prospective: ’(whoever) should come’ (ὅς κε … ἔλθοι) · also in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he go’ (μή … ἔλθοι ἀπαγγέλλων) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’whatever he might come in need of’ (ὅτευ κεχρημένος ἔλθοι)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’) · also doubled, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’this way and that’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with anastrophe, accent thrown back after its noun (δήμῳ ἔνι = ἐν δήμῳ) · also = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι (ἔνι with no case): ’there is, there are in it/among them’ (ἄνδρες νηῶν ἔνι τέκτονες ’men, shipwrights, are among them’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπιόν: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 pl. (accent from the following enclitic θ’) · also aor. 1 sg. (same form): ’I drank’ (ἔφαγόν τ’ ἔπιόν τε ’I ate and drank’)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’work’ (τόδε ἔργον ἀέξεται ’this work grows’)
ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg.
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔτικτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’begot’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
ἔχοις: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. opt. 2 sg. (wish): ’may you keep’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative (λώϊον ἠέ περ ἄλλοι ’better than others’)
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’ · also ’than’, ’rather than’, after a verb of preferring (βούλομ’ … ἤ τινα ’I prefer … to any’)
ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’the days’ (νύκτες τε καὶ ἤματα φθίνουσιν)
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also used as a vocative in direct address, inserted mid-sentence (ἥρως, εἴρεσθαι δέ ’and ask, hero that you are’), distinct from its use as a narrative title ’the hero’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing’
ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ‘coming’ · also ’going’ rather than ’coming’, the precise direction supplied by context: Τροίηθεν ἰόντες ’setting out from Troy, departing’
ἱερὴ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. nom. sg.
ἲς: ἴς (gen. ἰνός) — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg., in the periphrasis ἱερὴ ἲς + gen. ’the sacred strength of ...’, i.e. the hero himself · also plain ’force, might’ of a thing: ἲς ἀνέμοιο ’the force of the wind’
ἴδοντο: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= Attic εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἴμεναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι): ’to go’
ἴρου: Ἶρος — Irus, the town beggar; masc. gen. sg.
ἵκει: ἵκω — come upon, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
ἵκοιτ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (ἵκοιτ’ = ἵκοιτο), in a condition: ’should reach’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’ · also + opt. after a future main verb: ’so that … may’ (ἄξω … ἵνα … ἄλφοι ’I will take … so that he may bring in’)
ἶρον: Ἶρος — Irus, the town beggar; masc. acc. sg.
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg., double-σ form (metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆα)
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg. Ὀδυσῆα, elided (Ὀδυσῆ’ = Ὀδυσῆα)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth; adv. (ὀδὰξ ἐν χείλεσι φύντες ’having bitten their lips’)
ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. mid. inf.
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὁμάδησαν: ὁμαδέω — make a din, clamor; aor. 3 pl.
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’) · also + subj. without κε, in a general clause: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε τις μνήσῃ ’whenever anyone mentions’) · also + opt., of what may happen in time to come: ’whenever he should’ (ὁππότε νοστήσειε ’whenever he should come home’)
ὁρώμενος: ὁράω (mid.) — look at, gaze toward; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.; neut. often adverbial: ’as much as’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὔμμ: σύ — you; pl. acc. ὔμμε, epic/Aeolic (= Attic ὑμᾶς), elided (ὔμμ’ = ὔμμε)
ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; masc. nom. sg.
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤφελλ: ὀφέλλω (ὀφείλω) — owe, be bound; impf. 3 sg., elided (ὤφελλ’ = ὤφελλε), in an unfulfillable wish with ὡς: ’would that’
ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
ὥρῃ: ὥρα — season, time; fem. dat. sg.
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν: ’in his own (mind)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: which; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν: ’in which’ (ᾗσιν ἀγαλλόμενοι ’taking pride in which’)
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
